audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 3, 4 and 6 disagreed with their own why-text and with the packet chart.
audit.why: whys[3] opens 'You maintain the edge' but the row said Skill; whys[4] says 'do not fight her at 6' but the row said Skill; whys[6] says convert into structures rather than chase kills, which is not a Riven-owned stage. The mirror flipped exactly rows 3, 4 and 6.
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5 to Riven, Level 6 to Irelia at 4/10, two items to Skill; proposed as matched full/content pairs in one group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item spike and whys[5] build Trinity Force or Immortal Shieldbow, while the entry's own itemisation says Eclipse then Sterak's Gage. Level 6 also had no cooldown attached to Vanguard's Edge.
audit.why: A spike keyed to an item the page never tells you to buy is a timing that never arrives, and Vanguard's Edge at 125 seconds rank 1 is the longest cooldown in the lane — the number is what makes 'wait it out' actionable.
audit.corrected: whys[5] and spikes[2] moved to Eclipse; whys[4] carries the 125-second rank-1 number and the slow wall the blades leave behind.

audit.whatIsWrong: Defiant Dance appears nowhere on the page, and it is the single ability that most directly beats Riven.
audit.why: Riot's text: Irelia 'takes reduced physical damage during the charge'. Riven's entire kit is physical damage, so a combo dumped into a charging Defiant Dance is the worst-value rotation in the matchup — and it is a 20-second cooldown at rank 1, so waiting the charge out is a real, repeatable plan. Nothing on the page warned the player at all.
audit.corrected: whys[3] now pairs the Flawless Duet bait with 'wait the Defiant Dance charge out', and wants.you[1] repoints Valor from gap-closer to the shield that survives the follow-up.
sources: enemyKit W text 'takes reduced physical damage during the charge'

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[2] and wants.foe[0] both claim Ionian Fervor stacks 'to four'.
audit.why: Riot's description gives no stack count — it says stacking attack speed, with bonus on-hit damage at maximum stacks. A specific number the source does not support reads as precision the page has not earned, and the mirror already replaced the same claim from Irelia's side.
audit.corrected: Both strings now say max stacks and describe the attack-speed effect Riot actually names.

audit.whatIsWrong: Flawless Duet is the tracked cooldown on every screen of this entry with no duration anywhere.
audit.why: It is 16 seconds at rank 1 falling to 10 at rank 5 — a long enough gap that baiting it genuinely opens a full rotation, which is exactly why it is the tracked ability.
audit.corrected: whys[3] now states the 16-second rank-1 number.

edits.before: Full Q-W-E kit online: W-stun her before she can stack to four and your burst wins the short trade before her reset chain gets going.
edits.after: Full Q-W-E online: Ki Burst her before Ionian Fervor hits max stacks, and your burst wins the short trade before her resets start.

edits.before: You maintain the edge by baiting her E stun before committing — once Flawless Duet is burned, W into Q chain is free damage with no answer.
edits.after: Bait Flawless Duet — 16s at rank 1 — then Ki Burst into the Q chain. Defiant Dance cuts physical damage as she charges it, so wait the charge out.

edits.before: Vanguard's Edge guarantees her E-stun follow-up and her full passive-shred burst — do not fight her at 6 unless her blades have already missed you.
edits.after: Vanguard's Edge marks you and leaves a wall that slows anyone crossing it — do not fight at 6 until the blades miss. It is 125s at rank 1.

edits.before: Your Triforce or Shieldbow lands before her Blade of the Ruined King spike — force the extended trade while her healing and shred are still incomplete.
edits.after: Your Eclipse lands before her Blade of the Ruined King spike — force the extended trade while Bladesurge's healing and her shred are still incomplete.

edits.before: Trinity Force or Immortal Shieldbow lands while Irelia is still assembling Blade of the Ruined King — force the extended trade here before she gets her healing spike.
edits.after: Eclipse lands while Irelia is still assembling Blade of the Ruined King — force the extended trade here, before Bladesurge starts healing her out of every rotation.

edits.before: Bait her E stun before committing E-Q chain so she has no lockdown answer to your all-in
edits.after: Bait Flawless Duet before you commit, and hold Valor — its shield is what survives her burst

edits.before: Stack passive to four charges on the wave before engaging so every trade opens with maximum shred
edits.after: Stack Ionian Fervor to max on the wave first so every trade opens at full attack speed

notes: The packet's suspectName ('Land Vanguard's Edge') is a FALSE POSITIVE — that is the correct Riot name. The Executioner's Calling line in report[8].t and breakdown.late is legitimate on THIS page (Bladesurge heals her), though it is phrased 'his healing' about Irelia; that string carries mojibake em dashes so I left it for a byte-exact pass, along with the 'he/him' pronouns in tradeGood, breakdown.trading, report[3].t, breakdown.mid and breakdown.feeding. NOT asserted: the kit file tags Flawless Duet with a 'grounding' flag ('shuts off enemy dashes'), which would be enormous against Riven's Q and E dashes, but Riot's own description says only damaged, stunned and Marked — per the description-wins rule no grounding claim reached the page. Worth a human confirming, because if it is real it changes the Level 6 advice.
